title: Strong Lingering Bad Smell
text:
Strong Lingering Bad Smell. Bad smell that just won't go away, even after owning it a month. It's a strong smell and one that really is bothersome. I took the cover off and let it air for quite a while, and the smell is still the same.

It's a nice looking pillow and the cover is soft, and it might be an effective pillow for some. But with the bad lingering strong smell, I cannot recommend it.
